CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Rugby: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rugby.
   B. Practise Rugby with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rugby.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rugby.

2. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games: (1 mark)

   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games.

   A. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.

   B. Remove the need for rules

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
